items.prompt: One single standalone character reference image, cinematic stylized 3D animation, Edwardian 1910. The supplied input is the identity and costume source: keep EXACTLY the same fictional person, age, build, face proportions, hairstyle, facial hair or clean-shaven state, spectacles or absence, hat, fabric colours, garment cut, buttons, shoes and accessories. Only change camera angle/framing, not character design. No extra people, no duplicated figures, no labels or writing, no text, no watermark, no panels, no contact sheet, no collage. Not a real person portrait. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the ONLY identity, clothing, build, gender and appearance source. INPUT IMAGE 2 is ONLY the exact camera-angle/pose guide. Recreate image 1 character in image 2 pose and camera view. Never copy image 2 grey clothes, generic face or male body shape. Preserve image 1 gender and body shape.
